title: Okay
body: This app is ok, but you have to pay for so many things and only  a tiny bit of the app’s uses are free. I think if there were more options you don’t have to pay for it would be more beneficial. Additionally, the tracking part itself is a bit difficult for me personally.
author: 1239M:)

title: Best Habit Tracker There Is
body: I seriously love the concept of this app… I find that it motivates me to get things done but without the feeling of punishment when life gets in the way. Love the bonus of buying and planting a forest, the visuals are excellent. More people need to know about this one.
author: grievedghost

title: Great App but
body: I love the app. However, it could be improved if you make it possible to track multiple habits on the  widget. Currently, I am only able to select 1 habit to track at a time. So, I have to open the app to check which habits I have yet to complete.
author: J-/-;:

title: Brilliant app for habit building
body: Talk about positive reinforcement! Momentumly is a great take on the concept of streaks to motivate oneself to build a habit. The app is smart, playful and charming making it a delight to use.
author: Mehmet Can Alaca

title: Habit tracker that works!
body: I’ve tried a bunch of habit trackers and this is the first that has actually stuck. It’s beautifully simple and easy to start using.
author: Robbie_0717

title: Highly recommended!!!
body: Very addictive. It really helps you stick with your habits.
